about: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide is written in our own words from the official description. Counts (42 range challenges, 14 drone-race locations, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garage properties) are the numbers the game itself shows in its menus. Anything beyond the official description is marked in the guide text as a reasoned read — the game launched 19 Nov 2026 and no public guide existed yet, so no specific location or step is presented as fact unless the official description names it. Missable flags: no trophy in the official list is one-time-only; 'watch' marks the three trophies tied to a story beat — replay the mission if one does not pop.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Follow the roadmap in order: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, combat and money, then 100% completion, and this lands last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Play through the start of the story as Lucia and Jason; the trophy pops when Gone Fishing ends. Nothing to prepare — it is the first mission of the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story only — it pops at the chapter's final mission. If you are tracking progress, the chapter list in the pause menu shows which missions remain.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Story only — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Story only — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Story only — it pops at the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. One caution before you start it: the official description does not say whether side content stays open after the credits, so finish the stranger strands and the story-beat watch-list first, then play the finale.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears in the mission flow — play the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the story flow — it pops when the job is done.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It appears in the mission flow — play the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It appears in the mission flow — play the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown — a takedown at Vice City International Airport. It appears in the mission flow.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It appears in the mission flow — play the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The 100% checklist: story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counts in this guide. The game's stats screen lists what still counts toward 100% — work through it, and when every other trophy in this guide is done, check that screen for whatever is left. This is the last gold before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts — the game counts them as you drive. The counter is cumulative across the whole game, so 250 builds up naturally; to farm it, jump the city's ramps and bridges and chain near-misses on the highway.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers once — races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the WAiNK spots. The Activities menu lists the types; try one of each and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold every Shooting Range challenge — the range lists 42 of them. Gold needs accuracy and speed, so learn each challenge's target pattern with a bronze run first, then push for gold. All 42 must be gold; the range screen shows which ones still are not.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); in-game counter (42 challenges)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. The races are short, so a clean first lap usually wins — learn each course's line on a practice run, then race it.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); in-game counter (14 locations)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — any race type counts once each. Vary the vehicle class to suit each course; the counter tracks distinct races won, so repeating the same race does not add to it.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is a fishing contact — take his challenge when it appears and out-fish him. WATCH: the official description does not say whether Cal's challenge repeats. Do it the moment it appears; if it is a fishing-spot challenge, you can retry it until you win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any arcade cabinet to completion. Arcades are marked on the map — pick the shortest game first and finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand — every mission he offers, up to his last. Stranger strands open across Leonida; do Andy's missions as they appear on the map.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand — every mission he offers, up to his last. Do his missions as they appear on the map.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand — every mission he offers, up to his last. Do his missions as they appear on the map.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger strands — the five named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more. Work the stranger icons on the map as they appear; each strand ends with its own final mission.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand — every mission he offers, up to his last. Do his missions as they appear on the map.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand — every mission he offers, up to his last. Do his missions as they appear on the map.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. The spots are scenic overlooks — the map marks them once you find the first, so work through them district by district.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); in-game counter (18 spots)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's strand ends with a unique-animal hunt. Take the hunt when Bret offers it — the animal stays available until you bring it down, so it is not missable, but do it while the strand is open.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — check shops, interiors and landmarks; each set needs every card in it, so keep collecting until three sets are whole.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations. These are photo spots scattered across the map — the counter tracks distinct spots, so keep moving to new ones rather than repeating the same place.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Fifty challenges from the game's challenge list — driving, combat, exploration and more. The list shows your progress, so work through the easiest half first and let the rest build up as you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. The trophy needs your partner with you when the stars drop — lose them in alleys and back streets, not on the open highway.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the same wanted level through all three. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and do not let the heat drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Find 100 distinct vehicles — driving one counts as discovering it. Cruise every district and vehicle class; the counter tracks distinct models, so a new model each time is what counts.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, wait until the enemies group up, then trigger it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — steal a plane or otherwise exit through the airfield rather than the terminal. The airport is a restricted area, so go in ready for heat.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. The official description only jokes about it — it does not spell out the trigger — so the reasoned read is: engage a Rhino in combat (they appear at high wanted levels and military spots) and destroy one; if that does not pop it, try stealing one instead. Reasoned from the description, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Go in quiet, move fast, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted the attempt fails and you can retry it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults robbed, each followed by a clean escape. Vaults are the big jobs — plan the getaway before you go in, and do not start the next one until the heat from the last is gone.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck on the road and escape with the take. Trucks run set routes — wait for one, block it, crack it, and lose the heat before it builds.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive every highway and back road until no area is left grey. The area counter is in the map screen.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); in-game counter (52 areas)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, one illegal operation each. The game marks gang operations on the map — rob one per gang and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); in-game counter (9 gangs)

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a bar with a view over Ocean Beach and enjoy it. Any beachfront bar works — sit, order, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A showroom sequence — smash your way out in a vehicle. WATCH: this reads like a scripted story moment, so if it does not pop, replay the showroom mission from the mission replay menu.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates alley. Any full game counts — follow through on your shots and finish the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment — the description points to a story beat with your partner, but it does not name the mission. WATCH: play the story and it comes; if it is tied to a specific mission and does not pop, replay that mission. Reasoned from the description, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made across the game — the game tracks them cumulatively, so keep making story and dialogue choices as you play. The count builds up over the campaign; this is not a single one-time decision.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy's joke is the method. It pops on its own during normal play when a retry lands.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A strange world event — the kind of thing you stumble on while exploring Leonida. Keep playing and exploring; it triggers on its own and is not missable. Reasoned from the description, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass and swing as you go by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — feed them through contacts over time until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the game's shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything. It adds up across the whole campaign; big purchases late in the game finish it off.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Save up and buy them as they appear on the property market — the property screen shows which ones you still lack.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); in-game counter (8 properties)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle, open the app, and register it — ten distinct vehicles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
